> **Note:** This is a first exploratory description of the data. It may contain errors.

NHS Talking Therapies (NHS TT) publishes monthly, quarterly, and annual reports.
There could be several reasons for differences between the reporting periods.
For example, double counting would make the sums higher than the annual count, and late data submissions might make them lower.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(nhstt)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)

# The monthly and quarterly reports use measure IDs. The annual report uses names
measures <- tribble(
  ~measure_id , ~measure_name               , ~label                         ,
  "M001"      , "referrals_received"        , "Referrals received"           ,
  "M076"      , "finished_course_treatment" , "Finished course of treatment" ,
  "M191"      , "recovery"                  , "Recovery"                     ,
  "M193"      , "reliable_recovery"         , "Reliable recovery"
)

# NHS financial years run from April to March
financial_year <- function(date) {
  year_start <- year(date) - (month(date) < 4)
  paste0(year_start, "-", substr(year_start + 1, 3, 4))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
annual_england <- get_measures_annual() |>
  filter(
    org_type == "England",
    variable_type == "Total",
    measure_name %in% measures$measure_name,
    measure_statistic == "count"
  ) |>
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value))

monthly_england <- get_measures_monthly() |>
  filter(
    group_type == "England",
    measure_id %in% measures$measure_id,
    measure_statistic == "count"
  )

quarterly_england <- get_measures_quarterly() |>
  filter(
    org_type == "England",
    variable_type == "Total",
    measure_id %in% measures$measure_id,
    measure_statistic == "count"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: compare
annual <- annual_england |>
  inner_join(measures, by = "measure_name") |>
  transmute(financial_year = reporting_period, label, annual = value)

comparison <- bind_rows(
  monthly = monthly_england,
  quarterly = quarterly_england,
  .id = "report"
) |>
  inner_join(select(measures, measure_id, label), by = "measure_id") |>
  mutate(financial_year = financial_year(start_date)) |>
  summarise(
    summed = sum(value),
    n_periods = n_distinct(reporting_period),
    .by = c(report, financial_year, label)
  ) |>
  # Keep complete financial years only
  filter(n_periods == if_else(report == "monthly", 12, 4)) |>
  select(-n_periods) |>
  inner_join(annual, by = c("financial_year", "label")) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = measures$label),
    difference = summed - annual,
    percent_difference = 100 * difference / annual
  ) |>
  arrange(label, financial_year, report)

year_range <- function(which_report) {
  years <- comparison$financial_year[comparison$report == which_report]
  paste(range(years), collapse = " to ")
}
```

@tbl-comparison compares the annual counts (1 April to 31 March) with the sum of the monthly and quarterly counts for the same time interval.
The monthly and quarterly sums differ from the annual count by `r sprintf("%+.1f%%", min(comparison$percent_difference))` to `r sprintf("%+.1f%%", max(comparison$percent_difference))`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-comparison
#| tbl-cap: Annual, monthly, and quarterly counts for England by NHS financial year (1 April to 31 March).
comparison |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = report,
    values_from = c(summed, difference, percent_difference),
    names_vary = "slowest"
  ) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "label", rowname_col = "financial_year") |>
  tab_spanner("Monthly", ends_with("_monthly")) |>
  tab_spanner("Quarterly", ends_with("_quarterly")) |>
  cols_label(
    annual = "Annual",
    starts_with("summed") ~ "Sum",
    starts_with("difference") ~ "Δ",
    starts_with("percent_difference") ~ "Δ (%)"
  ) |>
  fmt_integer(c(annual, starts_with("summed"))) |>
  fmt_integer(starts_with("difference"), force_sign = TRUE) |>
  fmt_number(
    starts_with("percent_difference"),
    decimals = 2,
    force_sign = TRUE
  ) |>
  sub_missing() |>
  tab_style(
    cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = list(
      cells_column_labels(),
      cells_column_spanners(),
      cells_row_groups()
    )
  ) |>
  tab_footnote(
    "Δ: difference from the annual count."
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    cell_text(align = "left"),
    locations = list(cells_footnotes(), cells_source_notes())
  )
```
